_note: Wording for /language/kinyarwanda/speech-to-text. Scores, times, averages and transcripts come from language/data/kin/ (see scripts/build_language_pages.py render_stt). Each recognizer's transcripts come from the evaluation runs of the chain named in 'chain' (scripts/fetch_language_transcripts.py).
self_host: Omnilingual is an open-weight speech recognition model from Meta, so it can run on your own servers; paired with an open-weight language model such as DeepSeek V4, the whole Kinyarwanda chain can run on local hardware. Intron’s offline option still needs confirming for Kinyarwanda, and Gemini 3.1 Pro is a private API. Choose hardware that meets the models’ requirements and check each component’s licence and language support before deployment.
